lines.text: First as offerings. Then as incense.
lines.phonemes: fˈɜːst æz ˈɔfɚɹɪŋz. ðˈɛn æz ˈɪnsɛns.

lines.text: At Ujjain's Mahakal temple, women turned its flowers into over 30 million incense sticks.
lines.tts: At Ujjain's Mahakal temple, women turned its flowers into over thirty million incense sticks.
lines.phonemes: æɾ ʊdʒdʒˈeɪnz mˌʌhɑːkˈɑːl tˈɛmpəl, wˈɪmɪn tˈɜːnd ɪts flˈaʊɚz ˌɪntʊ ˌoʊvɚ θˈɜːɾi mˈɪliən ˈɪnsɛns stˈɪks.

lines.text: Dry the flowers, grind them, add a binder, and mould cones.
lines.tts: Dry the flowers, grind them, add a binder, and mold cones.
lines.phonemes: dɹˈaɪ ðə flˈaʊɚz, ɡɹˈaɪnd ðˌɛm, ˈæd ɐ bˈaɪndɚ, ænd mˈoʊld kˈoʊnz.

lines.text: Assume a hundred kilos of free flowers make 300 packs.
lines.tts: Assume a hundred kilos of free flowers make three hundred packs.
lines.phonemes: ɐsˈuːm ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd kˈiːloʊz ʌv fɹˈiː flˈaʊɚz mˌeɪk θɹˈiː hˈʌndɹɪd pˈæks.

lines.text: After binder, packing and labour, about ₹1,300 is left.
lines.tts: After binder, packing and labor, about thirteen hundred rupees is left.
lines.phonemes: ˈæftɚ bˈaɪndɚ, pˈækɪŋ ænd lˈeɪbɚ, ɐbˌaʊt θˈɜːtiːn hˈʌndɹɪd ɹˈuːpiːz ɪz lˈɛft.

lines.text: Ten rupees more per pack adds ₹2,700.
lines.tts: Ten rupees more per pack adds twenty-seven hundred.
lines.phonemes: tˈɛn ɹˈuːpiːz mˈɔːɹ pɜː pˈæk ˈædz twˈɛntisˈɛvən hˈʌndɹɪd.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
